title: Bibliometric trends and Eurostat evidence on AI in SMEs: data and code
description: Data and code for the paper 'Bibliometric Trends and Eurostat Evidence on Artificial Intelligence in Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises' (Barać, Uroš and Mihanović, GAME Conference Proceedings). The package contains the OpenAlex query result (2010-2025), annual counts of the same query in Scopus and Web of Science, Eurostat data on AI use and digital intensity by enterprise size (2021-2025), a 100-record relevance validation sample, a controlled vocabulary of 43 themes and a Python pipeline that reproduces all tables and figures of the paper (co-word network with Louvain clustering, centrality-density map, thematic evolution, database robustness, cross-country regressions).
